summary: Adjust network retry loop configuration in fetch_with_retry by shortening request timeout and increasing maximum attempt count.

items.title: Shorten request timeout from 30s to 5s and increase maximum retry attempts from 1 to 4
items.before: fetch_with_retry uses a 30-second timeout and allows only 1 attempt with no retries on timeout.
items.after: fetch_with_retry uses a 5-second timeout and allows up to 4 attempts (up to 3 retries after 1-second delays) on timeout.
